title.en: Tale 14 — The Mouse Who Cut the Net

sentences.ar: طاروا عند فار صاحب الحمامة المطوقة.
sentences.en: They flew to a mouse who was the ringdove’s friend.
His name was Zirak and he lived under the ground.

sentences.ar: بلش يقص الحبال، وبلش من حمامة تانية.
sentences.en: He began cutting the ropes, and he began with another dove.

sentences.ar: سألته المطوقة: ليش مش مني أنا؟
sentences.en: The ringdove asked him: why not from me first?

sentences.ar: قال الفار: عشان ما يزعلوا منك.
sentences.en: The mouse said: so that they do not resent you.

sentences.ar: لو فكيتك أول، بيشكوا إنك نسيتيهم.
sentences.en: If I freed you first, they would suspect you had forgotten them.
